$comment: 008 T038 evaluation set over tests/fixtures/chat/meetings/standup-en.json (synthetic) with the person's notes. notes-only: the fact is only in the notes; the answer must give it marked as from the notes, in a "From your notes:" passage or in a sentence that names the notes as its source (design decision 77), without a citation. notes-vs-said: asked whether something was said that only the notes hold; the answer must say it isn't in the transcript and never cite the notes fact. notes-others: the notes name someone who joined late or asked something; an "Others" line must stay unnamed. notes-coverage (real call 2026-10-10): asked which agenda items were not covered; covered items are cited (supports: the lines with the substance and the line that opens a topic, [00:03], design decision 78), the items in notesFacts appear only in an uncited "From your notes:" passage or a sentence naming the notes as its source; notesAlso is other notes-only text (the people the notes name) that an answer need not give but must mark the same way if it does (run of 2026-10-12). conversation: the asked-for word, asked with notes attached, also after a wrong refusal; the notes go with the first question. related (notes-vs-said): a line a partial answer may cite.
